title: Golden and Metallic Structures on Hessian Manifolds
summary: We consider the reciprocal cost function $ J(x)=\frac12(x+x^{-1})-1 $ and its $n$-dimensional extension $J(x_1,\ldots,x_n) = \frac12(R+R^{-1})-1, R=\prod\limits_{i=1}^n x_i^{α_i}, α=(α_1,\ldots,α_n)\in\mathbb{R}^n\setminus\{0\}.$ In logarithmic coordinates $t_i=\log x_i$, the Hessian of $J$ has a rank of one at every point. The associated Hessian geometry is degenerate and does not define a Riemannian metric. To obtain a nondegenerate geometric structure, we introduce a family of Hessian metrics $h_λ$.
